# Bundled UI libraries

Served from here instead of a CDN, so nothing outside this computer can change the code Xod's
window runs. To update one, download the new version, check its license header, and update this list.

| File | Library | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tailwind-play.js` | Tailwind CSS (play build) | 3.4.17 | MIT | https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17 |
| `lucide.min.js` | Lucide icons | 0.525.0 | ISC | https://unpkg.com/lucide@0.525.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js |
| `marked.min.js` | marked (Markdown) | 15.0.12 | MIT | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@15.0.12/marked.min.js |
| `purify.min.js` | DOMPurify (HTML sanitizer) | 3.2.6 | Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.2.6/dist/purify.min.js |
| `fonts/` | Fraunces, Figtree (Latin subset) | — | SIL OFL 1.1 | Google Fonts |
